company.name: ToRetail
company.description:
ToRetail is a global B2B2C e-commerce platform powered by artificial intelligence and designed for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) worldwide. We are creating the world’s first trading ecosystem that removes traditional barriers between manufacturers and buyers in 195+ countries, making international trade accessible, efficient, and transparent.

Who We Serve

B2B Suppliers of Goods and Services: The opportunity to sell products and services in local and international markets, including exports to more than 195 countries.
B2B Buyers: Direct access to verified manufacturers and suppliers worldwide, without intermediaries and with minimal costs.
B2C Customers: Purchase unique and local products at competitive prices, both domestically and internationally.

Our Solution

ToRetail is changing the paradigm of global trade through three key innovations:

Dual AI Agent System:
AISA (AI Supply Assistant) for manufacturers — automates catalog creation, pricing, market analysis, and inventory management in 100+ languages.
AIBA (AI Buyer Assistant) for buyers — intelligent supplier matching, negotiation support, and product quality control.

Zero Commission on Domestic B2B Transactions:
Suppliers retain full margin, while international transactions are subject to a minimal 2-3% commission — radically lower than market standards.

Integrated Ecosystem:
Built-in financial services (factoring, multi-currency accounts, insurance), logistics automation, export-import support, and localization for each market’s specifics.

Why Now

Market: The global B2B e-commerce market reached €10 trillion in 2024 and is projected to grow to €33 trillion by 2030 (CAGR 20.2%).
Trends: Explosive growth in digitalization, the development of AI and blockchain, and rapid expansion of e-commerce in developing countries.
Problem: 90% of global trade is driven by SMEs, which traditional platforms ignore due to language, cultural, and technical barriers, as well as high intermediary commissions.

Our Achievements

MVP Launch: June 2025, first users from Turkey, Kazakhstan, China, and Uzbekistan.
Partnerships: Collaboration with government trade organizations and industry associations.
Technology: Successful testing of AI agents with manufacturers from various industries.
Funding: Attracting venture capital in the Seed round to scale in the Middle East and CIS regions and develop AI models.

International Team of Experts in:

Wholesale and retail FMCG trade and B2B marketplaces (20+ years)
Export, import, market entry, business intelligence, brand adaptation, and export logistics
Technology team management, scalable AI and blockchain solutions, high-load platform development (up to 100+ million MAU)
B2B marketing and strategic analysis, brand building and development, digital marketing, content, and communications
Our Goals

Mission: Democratize global trade, making products from any country accessible to wholesale and retail buyers worldwide.
Vision: By 2035, become the global operating system for B2B2C trade, evolving from a marketplace to the infrastructure layer of global commerce.
Plans: By 2030 — 2+ million active suppliers, 10+ million active buyers, presence in 50+ countries, IPO preparation.

Why Invest in ToRetail

Unique Business Model: Zero commission on domestic transactions, low export fees, multi-tier subscription, and additional services.
Technological Leadership: Deep integration of AI and blockchain, support for 100+ languages, mobile accessibility, and localization.
Focus on Fast-Growing Markets: Middle East, CIS, Asia, Latin America — regions with the highest growth potential.
Growth Potential: Expected returns for early investors — up to 100x by 2030.
Join the Transformation of Global Trade!

We invite you to join us in building the future of global commerce — a future where geographic boundaries do not limit economic opportunities, where small businesses compete on merit, not size, and where technology serves humanity rather than replacing it. Together, we will democratize international trade and unlock human potential worldwide.

The revolution in global trade begins with ToRetail. The future is intelligent, inclusive, and international. The future is now.
